scope: Two independent production-code experiments: integer thresholds and packed short UTF-8 comparisons. Combine only if both merit follow-up.
decision: Screen each candidate separately against current optimized Java. Only promising candidates enter independent confirmation. Retain a candidate only for a resolved >=2% gain in the confirmation at 10k, with no resolved regression at either larger size. Unresolved larger-pool results remain explicitly inconclusive; do not claim equivalence.
controls: One JVM mean per independent sample
Rotate version order every round and pool
Identical committed benchmark and correctness tests across versions
Run classfile and bench tests before measurement
No builds, tests or other benchmarks during timing
Each measured invocation must last at least one second
Preserve raw results, source and revision hashes, commands, and discarded branches
